integrity.proof_basis: Elementary complex-unit-circle rigidity, Chinese remainder theorem, exact finite abelian congruence counts and arithmetic factorization.

scientific_limitations: Three-element subsets of finite cyclic groups only; literal distinct spectra, not translation-equivalence classes or higher-dimensional spectral measures. Finite computation tests finitely many cyclic orders and does not prove the infinite-family claim. Underlying individual-pair Hadamard criterion is prior work; an older equivalent enumeration might be unindexed.
title: Complete three-point spectral multiplicities on finite cyclic groups
